description: Use this when prepaying a btf_ balance (starter 1,000 sats/$1, standard 5,000/$5, bulk 25,000/$25; 365-day expiry; redeemable only for BitTuitive services; non-transferable; no cash value; non-refundable; failed calls not charged). Lightning: pass bundle or amount_sats (100-1,000,000), pay, then retry with payment_hash + credit_token. x402 USDC: pass bundle or amount_usd (0.10-50) + x402_payment.

credit_token.description: Prepaid btf_ token (omit on first create_feed).

payment_hash.description: Paid Lightning invoice hash to credit.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).

name: buy_credits
title: Buy prepaid credits (Lightning or USDC)
